indicator_name: Producer Price Index, industrial products, year-on-year
description: Индекс цен производителей промышленной продукции, к соответствующему месяцу прошлого года
methodology: Index, same month of the previous year = 100: producer prices of industrial products, national, monthly from 2011-01 (Taldau index 703039). December/December values equal BNS element 1626 for 2011-2025. The annual PPI series is a different figure -- the January-December average.
